row.name: Quest Diagnostics Incorporated Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=9 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.34 tightness=0.97 base_volume_vs_leg=0.98 base_volume_vs_avg=0.98
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: volume did not exceed the prior session's

notes: extension: close -1.8% vs its 20-SMA, -0.4% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 1 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The burst bar gains only 1.68% — well below the 4% minimum Bonde requires for a range-expansion day — and the metrics confirm it: RE fails because the bar is not even the widest of the last five sessions, and VOL fails because volume did not exceed the prior session. The shaded base itself shows multiple wide overlapping red and green bars spanning roughly 18 points (~8% of price), which is loose rather than tight, and the consolidation sits below the prior highs rather than holding near them. These three failures together — sub-4% burst, no range expansion, no volume confirmation — mean there is no burst here by definition.
claude.key_risk: The stock is already rolling over from its highs with a series of lower closes inside the base, and a sub-4% 'burst' on below-average volume offers no edge for a 3–5 day momentum trade.
claude.entry_note: Skip regardless of the open — the burst bar itself does not qualify under the 4% minimum gain rule, so no open price rescues this setup.

row.summary: DGX: +1.7% out of a base 7.5% deep. skip 10.0, 6 of 6 criteria.
